notes.title: Patch 2.1.2a
notes.content:
A patch to fix a few bugs. Check it out:

[list]
[*] There are a few scenes in which some tracks overlapped. Now, they have been fixed.
[*] A bug in which Fernando's scene (the image, literally speaking) freezes has been fixed.
[*] The main game now needs 1400 MB (or 1.4GB) of disk space.
[*] The DLC now needs 230 MB of disk space.
[/list]
[h1][h2][b]TO AVOID BUGS, PLEASE, PRESS F11, DELETE ALL SAVE FILES AND RESTART THE GAME![/b][/h2][/h1]

Thank you [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1468430/discussions/0/2989791584239132058/?ctp=2]Vamyr [/url]for your report!

Male Doll Team

notes.title: Patch 2.1.0a
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

A few Steam players [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1468430/discussions/0/2989791584239132058/]reported[/url] to me that the gallery wasn't working properly - some scenes were still blocked even when you had completed the whole game. So, [b]I fixed it by making two different galleries (SFW and NSFW)[/b]. The NSFW gallery has only the sexual scenes in the same order as the SFW gallery (Anderson's first and then Fernando's). Check it out:

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/34679897/20106580a4a4fec36db4c8e79c908da47b3f0c4a.png[/img]
Also, [b]now at the beginning of the NSFW build you'll be able to choose if you want to play a NSFW or a SFW run. This means people who download the NSFW build can still play the SFW without having to download a new one.[/b]

Thank you all for your reports and for your patience.

Victoria Invicta

tags.bug: I fixed it by making two different galleries (SFW and NSFW).

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2a
notes.content:
--> This patch is exclusively to fix a black screen problem <--

After we updated the game to version 1.0.1a, some people messaged us to tell us about a black screen bug. When they started the game, buttons appeared but the images don't. We've made some tests, a tester has tested this new version, and seems the bug has been fixed.

Feel free to join [url=https://discord.com/invite/4y4bwRh]Discord[/url] to report any bugs you found and don't forget to follow our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/maledoll]Steam page[/url]!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1a
notes.content:
This patch has a few improvements/corrections only for the Brazilian Portuguese translation. Check them out:

[list]
[*] In both routes, Alexandre mentioned the names of their partners which don’t correspond to that route. Now, we’ve fixed this;
[*] There is one option on Fernando’s route which keeps appearing in English even if you are on the Brazilian Portuguese version. After months of trying to understand why this was happening, we have fixed this too.
[/list]

Thank you all for supporting us and don’t forget to follow our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/maledoll]Steam page[/url] because new games will be announced soon.

Male Doll Team
